1. Browse Items - Look for items you're interested in
2. Check Pod Values - Make sure you have items of similar value
3. Propose Trade - Click 'Propose Trade' on the item
4. Add Your Items - Select what you want to trade
5. Send Message - Explain why it's a good trade
6. Wait for Response - Other user accepts, declines, or counters
7. Arrange Meetup - Choose safe public location
8. Complete Trade - Exchange items and rate each other
• Start with small-value items to build reputation\n• Be flexible - consider multi-item trades\n• Communicate clearly and promptly

Pods are our trade units to make bartering fair:
• 1 Pod = 1 Pod (not real currency)
• Helps compare item values easily
• Makes multi-item trades possible

• 1-3 Pods: Small items (books, accessories, small plants)
• 4-7 Pods: Medium items (kitchenware, electronics, clothing)
• 8-12 Pods: Large items (furniture, appliances, gadgets)
• 13+ Pods: High-value items (collectibles, premium brands)
• Consider item condition, age, and demand\n• Check similar items for reference\n• Be realistic - overpricing reduces trade chances

• Meet in busy public places (malls, cafes, parks)
• Bring a friend if possible
• Meet during daylight hours
• Tell someone where you're going
• Inspect items before trading
• Trust your instincts

• Don't share personal information
• Don't trade prohibited items
• Don't feel pressured to trade
• Don't go alone for high-value trades
